newsitem.title: UK: Kasyanov says Russia needs IMF help for '96 budget.
newsitem.headline: Kasyanov says Russia needs IMF help for '96 budget.

text.p: Russia's Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov said on Friday Russia would face problems meeting the 1996 budget without help from the International Moetary Fund (IMF).
"If there were no credits from the IMF we would face problems financing the budget in 1996. In any case, we do expect to receive the $1 billion due from the IMF by the end of 1996," he said.
Russia did not receive the October tranche of a $10 billion three-year IMF loan but Kasyanov said the IMF will make decision about November tranche next week.
"The fact that we did not get the IMF credit in October has not affected the functioning and payment of the budget," he added.
Kasyanov was speaking at a news conference also attended by Finance Minister Alexander Livshits before meeting London investors as part of a roadshow for the country's debut Eurobond.
The deal is expected to be up to $500 million and is likely to be launched at the end of November. --Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
